work_completed: Added independent Transformers/Safetensors and llama.cpp/GGUF decision adapters that validate semantic intents without returning or applying physical state.

Added a loopback FastAPI endpoint for nlt.agent-loop.v1 perception-to-intent requests, with async worker-thread inference, correlation/grounding validation, one in-flight request per avatar, and fail-closed errors.
Documented local model setup, HTTP endpoint usage, runtime boundaries, and updated the optional Transformers minimum for Qwen3 compatibility.
work_in_progress: Pull request review and cross-repository runtime integration.
blockers: Fusion's model decision seam is not wired into SessionOrchestrator; the HTTP endpoint is the current integration path.
No cross-process Godot-to-Fusion end-to-end run has been recorded.
decisions_made: Use loopback HTTP request/response for the single-avatar low-frequency integration; the endpoint binds to 127.0.0.1 by default.
Keep GGUF and Transformers as separate optional local model paths; do not add model weights to Git.
Keep ASFDK governance, live-world revalidation, and physical execution on the Godot side.
handoff_record.next_agent_notes: Review the PR and coordinate with the nlt-world-engine transport client implementation. The endpoint defaults to a deterministic model-free control decision unless FUSION_GGUF_MODEL points to a local GGUF file. The real local GGUF adapter smoke test passed; the HTTP endpoint tests use injected decision functions. Do not describe this as a verified cross-process end-to-end run.
